args.title: Bouldering with Ren
args.body: Start with the longer forearm warmup, then do easy open-hand traverses and vertical footwork. Check the repaired right shoe progressively with easy edging before gradually loading into harder attempts. Step back and contact the clinician if pain exceeds 2/10, symptoms last 30 minutes, or any symptoms appear the next morning.
